class_label: academic gown, academic robe, judge's robe
focus_areas: Fabric drape physics and gravity consistency
Boundary sharpness between gown and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands of the figure on the right. Ensure the fingers are distinct and not melting into the purple velvet sleeve lining. Verify that the vertical panels on the front of the gown remain parallel and do not warp unnaturally near the waist. Check for any bleeding between the gown hem and the white background.
image_description: The image displays two individuals wearing academic regalia against a white background. The figure on the left is shown from the back, wearing a grey/beige gown with a dark vertical panel and a doctoral tam (soft cap). The figure on the right faces forward, wearing a black gown with purple velvet panels and three bars on the sleeves (indicating a doctoral degree), along with a mortarboard cap. Both gowns exhibit the characteristic voluminous cut and wide sleeves.
